scope: Host-side testbench functional environment on the existing core_mem_if_v1 external interface. It is not production Chisel RTL, HBM, SRAM, a controller, CDC, or an authority owner.

transaction_rules.init: one init_ack handshake per local reset epoch before accepted R1 traffic
transaction_rules.request_backpressure: request ready may legally stall; no accepted request is dropped or duplicated
transaction_rules.read: exact preloaded payload fragment vector only when expected_fragment_count matches, otherwise one terminal fault
transaction_rules.write: stage ordered write-data and materialize only on accepted successful terminal response
transaction_rules.response_backpressure: head response remains stable until R1 ready
transaction_rules.reset: suppress queued responses and staged writes while preserving fixture objects; R1 retains stale/mismatch suppression

fixture_object.limit: generation and sidecar are fixture metadata only and are not inferred, validated, or emitted by core_mem_if_v1

fault_injection: one next-read or next-write terminal fault for directed fail-closed coverage only
post_replacement_prohibition: covered directed tests may not use direct manual response pokes or direct S2 mutation as substitutes for an accepted functional-memory transaction
forbidden: latency bandwidth throughput or PPA claim
payload metadata or residency authority transfer
scheduler admission pruning or atomic-publication change
